evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies connection management and peer selection in src/net.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
rationale: Adds the `-v2onlyclearnet` option allowing node operators to enforce BIP324 encryption across clearnet connections. As noted in the discussion, this prevents plaintext leakage over unencrypted v1 fallback connections and mitigates passive inspection by on-path observers.
